dedupe_keys.name: resilient 3d printed infrastructure with engineered cementitious composites ecc

description: University of New Mexico researchers publish test results for engineered cementitious composites intended for three-dimensional printing in civil infrastructure. Zenodo supplies an Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. The project description links material rheology, strength and ductility to the aim of printing structural components without conventional embedded reinforcement. These measurements can inform material-property assumptions in simulations of printed bridge or other built assets. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this test-results workbook. Coverage is the laboratory formulations assessed by this project, not a validated replacement for reinforced concrete in every loading environment. The description contains intended work as well as findings; it does not define all workbook columns or claim field durability. Fibre content, curing and printing geometry may matter. No workbook was downloaded or structural performance reproduced.
name: Resilient 3D-Printed Infrastructure with Engineered Cementitious Composites (ECC)
